title: Laser Halloween Spooktacular
description: Celebrate Halloween under the planetarium dome with laser-drawn images and a family-friendly soundtrack featuring Halloween favorites.
sourceDescriptionRaw: Laser Halloween Spooktacular is listed by the De Anza College Planetarium for Saturday, October 24, 2026, with 5:15 PM and 7:00 PM performances. The program is a family Halloween laser show under the planetarium dome.
